title: Catherine A NDE 7109
content: This new procedure was a very traumatic time for me. I went through a lot of pain with this experience. I am not a writer. But my experience has to be told. I feel very strongly about that. I was 11 years old when our doctor told my mother that I had idiopathic scoliosis, an abnormal curvature of my spine. I would need an operation to fix it. At the time, this operation was experimental. The year was 1971. We went to the Children's Hospital and I stayed there for a long time, I think it was 8 to 12 months. I just can't remember. I came home with a full body cast. While I was there, after the first operation, I died. I remember waking up in the Intensive Care Unit with my mother sitting beside me. I told her this story: While the doctors were operating on me, I could hear them saying, 'She is not responding.' Then I could hear them and see them, but their voices were hard to understand. I am watching them but I am not sure what they are saying, but I can feel their panic. I feel sorry for them. I turn my head away so I don't have to look at them. I told my mom that I was walking under a wave, a HUGE wave, and I was not getting wet. There were colors of the rainbow that I have never seen. Inside this wave, I felt happy and I had no pain. I was so glad to be there. I did not know that I could feel this much joy! I saw an old woman up ahead of me. I could only see her back. She had curly grey hair and a slender body. There were also lots of people and no bodies! I just felt their presence all around me. I still feel their presence to this day. I could hear her telling me to 'hurry up'; she had so much to tell me. When I got closer to her, she turned around and I looked at her in awe! She had 'my face' 'my eyes' 'my nose' 'my hair' she looked just like me: just an older version. She told me that she was 84 years old. She said, 'Catherine you can't come here right now.' I remember crying. I told her that this body had too much pain and I didn't want it. I asked her if she could give me another one. She looked deep into my eyes, (I remember feeling like I was looking at a million stars) and she said, 'You have to live in that body and it won't always hurt you. You have to learn to live with it. You have so many things you have to do before you can come here. You can't die until you are 84.' She went on to say that I have to help people that needed me. She said you're needed to help people find their gifts. She said everyone has one. I have a gift to show them and help them find their gifts. There was so much for me to do! She told me to, 'Turn around and go back.' When I did, I saw some doctors in this big room with a glass where a bunch of doctors were sitting, watching a team of doctors operating on me. I could hear their thoughts and feelings. I remember one doctor saying or thinking that this operation was bogus and they were using people as guinea pigs. He felt sorry for me. They put screws in my head and pins in my legs. The voices in my head were filled with negative thoughts. My mother said I told her I did not want to be a guinea pig. She wondered where I had heard that word. I believe that we are all born with gifts; we just lose sight of them as we live this life experience. I will never forget this experience. Much love, Catherine

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Walking under/inside a HUGE wave; later seeing doctors in a big room with a glass where doctors watched an operating team.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Walking under/inside a HUGE wave and not getting wet.

arrival.other_being_detail: An old woman who looked like Catherine (older version of herself) and said she was 84; also 'lots of people and no bodies' felt as presences.

environment.environment_other_detail: Inside/under a huge wave; 'colors of the rainbow that I have never seen'; not getting wet.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told she 'have to help people that needed me' and help people find their gifts; told she cannot die until she is 84.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Experimental scoliosis operation at Children's Hospital.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Walking under/inside a huge wave with unfamiliar rainbow colors; hearing doctors' thoughts/feelings; encountering an older version of herself who gave instructions and future information.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE perceptions of surgery occurred; then wave/realm and encounter with older-self figure; then viewing doctors behind glass and hearing thoughts; then return (woke in ICU).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Encountered an 'old woman' who was an older version of herself (age 84) with the same face/eyes/nose/hair; heard doctors' thoughts and feelings; 'lots of people and no bodies' felt as presences.
